title: The Lancashire Creamery Butterscotch Ice Cream Deluxe 10ml E-Liquid
description: Butterscotch Ice Cream Deluxe by Lancashire Creamery is a rich and indulgent dessert vape, pairing smooth Vanilla Ice Cream with golden, buttery Butterscotch. The Butterscotch offers deep caramelised sweetness with a mellow, warming edge, while the Ice Cream note softens the blend with creamy lightness. Together they create a well-rounded flavour that’s both luxurious and comforting, perfect for those who prefer dessert flavours with depth and balance. Formulated with nicotine salts for fast-acting nicotine delivery and a smooth, tactile throat hit, this e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio. It’s designed for use in low-powered pod kits, vape pens, and starter devices. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths to suit a range of preferences. Lancashire Creamery crafts all its e-liquids in the UK, with a focus on authentic dessert flavours that deliver warmth, comfort, and lasting satisfaction in every puff.
